series_synopsis: Ek investigation ke mutabiq, hacker ne sirf paanch hazaar dollar me so se zyada websites hack kar li hain. Microsoft aur doosri companies is naye khatre se kaise nipat rahi hain?

full_script.title: AI Hacker Ne 100 Websites Kaise Urayin? #tech
full_script.description: Reportedly, ek hacker ne sirf $5,000 me 100 se zyada websites hack kar lin. Janiye Microsoft aur aap isse kaise bach sakte hain.
full_script.narration: Ek recent investigation ke mutabiq, ek hacker ne sirf paanch hazaar dollar ke computer resources use karke aik sau se zyada websites ko compromise kar liya. Lekin ye AI agent hota kya hai? Ye aik aisi software technology hai jo khud se faisle leti hai aur bina insani madad ke bade tasks poore karti hai. Reportedly, hacker ne ishi autonomous AI agent ka use kiya jo itna tez aur sasta tha ke palak jhapte hi kaam ho gaya. Ab is baat par Microsoft aur doosri badi tech companies bohot fikrmand hain, aur wo aisi controls la rahi hain jo aisi risky AI agents ko detect aur restrict kar saken. Lekin sawal ye hai ke kya ye hamare liye bhi khatra hai? Aapke accounts, data aur passwords par iska kya asar pad sakta hai? Isse bachne ke liye do aasan tareeqay hain: aik toh hamesha two-factor authentication on rakhen, aur doosra har jagah unique password use karen. Ab sochiye aur batayiye, kya AI aage chal kar aur khatarnak ho jayega?
